scope: synthetic seeded scenarios, no industrial validation

baseline.definitions: One server per stage; buffers count waiting jobs only. Blocking after service retains machine slot. Planned downtime pauses processing; job can be assigned during downtime. Productive utilization excludes downtime; blocked fraction and planned downtime may overlap. Completed-only flow and started-only queue waits are censored finite-horizon metrics. At equal times: mark completions, downstream-first transfer/dispatch to stability, then each arrival with settlement. Nominal bottleneck is largest cycle adjusted by planned availability; intervention effect requires scenario comparison.
baseline.scope: synthetic simulation only; not operationally validated
